title: questions
description: Clarification questions about a ticket's acceptance criteria, written by /draft-cases (Story 4.2) next to the case file as cases/<KEY>.questions.json and committed in PR 1. An empty list means no questions. Consumer: n8n W6 posts them to Slack for approval (Story 6.7).
